info.name: Votiix API Test Collection
info.description: Comprehensive API tests for Votiix voting system - 92 test cases covering all KrakenD gateway endpoints including voting pipeline, hardware, and vote verification.

exec: pm.test('Service healthy', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(j.service).to.eql('votiix-core'); });

pm.test('Election created', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.title).to.eql('Test Election 2024'); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('Draft'); pm.collectionVariables.set('election_id', j.id); });
pm.test('Party created', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql('Freedom Party'); pm.collectionVariables.set('party_id', j.id); });

item.name: TC-P03: Create Party - Missing Short Code

exec: pm.test('Contest created', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.officeTitle).to.eql('President'); pm.collectionVariables.set('contest_id', j.id); });
pm.test('Candidate created', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql('John Candidate'); pm.collectionVariables.set('candidate_id', j.id); });

pm.test('JWT returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.jwt).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(j.session_id).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(j.expires_in_seconds).to.eql(60); pm.collectionVariables.set('auth_jwt', j.jwt); pm.collectionVariables.set('session_id', j.session_id); });

item.name: TC-KA02: Auth Session - Missing Fingerprint ID
TC-KA03: Auth Session - Missing Terminal ID
TC-KA04: Auth Session - Invalid Fingerprint Range
TC-TS01: Sign Token - Valid JWT & Blinded Token

exec: pm.test('Signed token returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.signed_blinded_token).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(j.election_id).to.not.be.undefined; pm.collectionVariables.set('signed_blinded_token', j.signed_blinded_token); });

item.name: TC-TS03: Sign Token - Missing Blinded Token
TC-TS05: Get Public Key - Valid Election

exec: pm.test('Public key returned', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.public_key).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(j.election_id).to.not.be.undefined; });

TC-TS07: Get Public Key - Non-Existent Election
TC-VC02: Commit Vote - Invalid Contest ID
TC-VC04: Commit Vote - Invalid Token Signature
TC-VV01: Verify Vote - Valid TX Hash
TC-VV02: Verify Vote - Non-Existent TX Hash

exec: pm.test('Has vote stats', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.total_committed_votes).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(j.election_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('election_id')); pm.expect(j.contests).to.not.be.undefined; });
pm.test('Service healthy', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(j.service).to.eql('votiix-token'); });

item.name: TC-H07: Health Check - Vote Engine Service

exec: pm.test('Service healthy', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql('ok'); pm.expect(j.service).to.eql('votiix-vote-engine'); });
pm.test('User registered', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.success).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.user_id).to.not.be.undefined; pm.collectionVariables.set('hw_user_id', j.user_id); });
